title: A refused act on a key removal leaves a security event
assertion: Each refusal of the closed list of eight reasons (`not_permitted`, `two_people`, `not_own_account`, `requester_left`, `one_administrator_request`, `asked_again_too_soon`, `target_asks`, `no_third_administrator`) writes one security event for the acting account in a transaction of its own, by IDs only, once an hour for an account and a reason; any other reason is refused; the web writes its line for every refused act, and the person reads the same words whether or not the event could be recorded
noFileReason: Synthetic accounts the tests insert; no file.
